1.text: Woe to every scorner and mocker

2.text: Who collects wealth and [continuously] counts it.<sup foot_note="228285">1</sup>

footnotes.228285: - Rather than spending in the way of Allāh.

3.text: He thinks that his wealth will make him immortal.

4.text: No! He will surely be thrown into the Crusher.<sup foot_note="228286">1</sup>

footnotes.228286: - i.e., Hellfire, which crushes and destroys all that enters it.

5.text: And what can make you know what is the Crusher?

6.text: It is the fire of Allāh, [eternally] fueled,

7.text: Which mounts directed at the hearts.<sup foot_note="228287">1</sup>

8.text: Indeed, it [i.e., Hellfire] will be closed down upon them

footnotes.228288: - Interpreted to be either columns of fire or columns of iron to which are chained the inmates of Hell.
